mutations.name: an attested closure is never compared with the lock
kills: an added row attesting a step unchanged at a closure the step has moved off fails

mutations.name: an attestation beside a version bump is accepted
kills: an added row attesting a step unchanged while the branch bumps its version fails

mutations.name: base rows are judged against the lock too
kills: a base row whose closure the step has since left is not re-judged
